steps.en: Install the single binary from your package manager
steps.zh: 用包管理器装上这个单一二进制
steps.code: brew install fzf · sudo apt install fzf · winget install fzf

steps.en: Source its shell integration once in your rc file
steps.zh: 在 shell 配置文件里 source 一次它的集成脚本

steps.en: Press a key binding — or pipe any list into fzf
steps.zh: 按一个快捷键——或把任意列表用管道喂给 fzf

steps.en: Collects the list (walks the directory or reads history) and opens the finder
steps.zh: 收集列表（遍历目录或读历史），打开挑选界面

steps.en: Type a few scattered letters of what you want
steps.zh: 随手敲几个想要的那项里的字母

steps.en: Re-ranks every line by fuzzy-match score on each keystroke
steps.zh: 每敲一个键，按模糊匹配分数把整张列表重新排序

steps.en: On Enter, writes the selection to stdout or onto your command line
steps.zh: 回车后把选中项写到标准输出或贴到命令行上

value.en: Any long list — files, history, branches, PIDs — becomes pick-by-typing a few letters, without leaving the shell
value.zh: 文件、历史命令、分支、PID，任何长列表都变成敲几个字母就能挑中，不用离开 shell

sources: https://github.com/junegunn/fzf README (fetched 2026-10-08): 'Using Homebrew' brew install fzf; 'Linux packages' sudo apt install fzf; 'Windows packages' winget install fzf; 'Setting up shell integration' eval "$(fzf --bash)" / source <(fzf --zsh); 'Key bindings for command-line' CTRL-T / CTRL-R / ALT-C; 'Usage' reads the list from STDIN, writes the selected item to STDOUT, and without a pipe traverses the file system
